title: EVA-00, EVA-01 and EVA-02 profiles on the runner
goal: The other three classes run on the same runner, each under its own profile
acceptance: EVA-00 with no network and no writes outside its scratch space; EVA-01 with writes only in granted paths and connections only to granted localhost ports (an egress proxy); EVA-02 with granted paths and granted ports on any host; no class reaches NERV's own ports
Join tests per class, each limit also shown to fail through a sandbox-exec that drops the profile
privacy: Neutral repository-owned fixtures only; no credentials, model calls or external effects in tests.
escalation: New upstream API work belongs to its owning repository; NERV supplies adapters

effort.basis: Re-estimated 2026-11-14 from 0.5 h to 0.75 h: feature implementation steps closed since 2026-11-13 took 0.75–1 h (F-066-T01, F-066-T02, F-062-T03, F-044-T01) where the 0.25x pass had set 0.25–1 h; started from this step's estimate, not a ratio. Re-estimated 2026-11-19 from 0.75 h to 3 h and narrowed (owner decision): moving action execution out of the scheduler became F-049-T14.
